headline: 'Zombie Debt Collection' by Financial Firms Halted... Lee: 'Debt Will Grow 10 or 20 Times Until We Die'
summary: The government is curbing financial companies that received tax relief after writing off personal overdue loans, then repeatedly extended extinguishment periods to continue collection. It plans a conditional bad-debt recognition system.
why: Debt collection and bad-debt write-off rules shape the earnings and credit recovery of consumer lenders and debt buyers in Korea.
